preserved: Player/captain, ship and alliance introduction fragments and their Supox echoes remain separate. Dynamic names are not replaced.
Earth/Vlik/nutritious dirt explanation, Root star versus common roots, flowers, bark, leaves and sunlight retain their distinct uses.
Utwig cultural dependence and friendship, Supox skepticism about the Ultron and admission of complicity remain the speakers views, not objective confirmation that the device is worthless.
Partial/near-complete/complete Ultron repair responses remain distinct; the Ultimate Weapon concern remains a possibility.
Pre/during/post-war accounts preserve exhaustion, tactical learning, losses and Ur-Quan friendly-fire misunderstanding. Antares and Horologii references are retained without harmonizing the source.
Sa-Matra transmission points toward Crateris, not an exact star or coordinate; Beta Leporis radiation and processed radioactives remain exploration clues.
Ship aid refusal and offer remain conditional dialogue alternatives; no quantity is invented from HAVE_4_SHIPS identifier.
OUT_TAKES retains the actor complaint and unexpected desire to eat a dog, not a hot-dog substitution.
